verdict.rationale: Spline exposes agent-facing surfaces (an MCP server driving the live editor, Code API, webhooks, Real-time API), so a sandbox or test environment is a fair question, but no evidence documents one that is isolated from production files or data. The 'sandboxed iframe' in the Code tab is browser rendering isolation for custom HTML, not a test environment. Version history is rollback after the fact, not isolation, and neither is a dry-run or sandbox mode.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
